subject: Literature
subcategory: Classic Novels That Changed the World
title: Beloved and the Legacy of Slavery
description: A short lesson to help you apply Beloved and the Legacy of Slavery.

hook.text: Toni Morrison based Beloved on the true story of a mother who killed her child to save her from slavery.

buildup.text: The novel explored how slavery's trauma haunted survivors long after physical chains were removed.

discovery.text: Morrison used fragmented, poetic prose to mirror the shattered memories of formerly enslaved people.

twist.text: When the Pulitzer jury initially passed over it, forty-eight Black writers signed an open protest letter.

climax.text: Beloved won the Pulitzer Prize in 1988 and later helped Morrison win the Nobel Prize in Literature.

punchline.text: Morrison made America remember what it wanted to forget.

quiz.question: What true event inspired Toni Morrison's Beloved?
options: A mother who killed her child to prevent her return to slavery
The signing of the Emancipation Proclamation
